Role: GenAI Architect
Locations: Hyderabad & Bangalore
Job Type: Full-Time
Budget: As Per Market Standards
Experience: 10 years (8+ Years in Python Development)

Immediate Joiners / Short Notice Preferred




Mandatory Skills:




Generative AI (GenAI)
Python Development (8+ Years Mandatory)
LLMs & AI Frameworks
Prompt Engineering
FastAPI / Microservices
AI/ML Solution Architecture
REST APIs & Integrations
Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)




Key Responsibilities:




Design and architect enterprise-grade GenAI solutions and AI platforms
Build scalable AI applications using Python and modern AI frameworks
Work on LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, and AI automation workflows
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver AI-driven business solutions
Define architecture standards, security, scalability, and governance for AI systems
Mentor engineering teams and drive innovation initiatives




Preferred Candidate Profile:




Strong hands-on Python coding experience
Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Llama, LangChain, or similar frameworks
Knowledge of vector databases, AI orchestration, and cloud-native architectures
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
